verdict.rationale: Paperspace ships a web-based Jupyter IDE (Notebooks) and advertises simple SSH root access to Machines, which underlies VS Code Remote-SSH connectivity, but there's no first-party one-click VS Code/Cursor integration and a hands-on community report says SSH access on Paperspace Core VMs is actually an 'uphill battle' with a 'pointless virtual console instead of simple ssh access,' contradicting the marketing claim of 'bring your SSH key and connect directly.' Missing for 10: documented one-click VS Code/Cursor connector, resolution of the SSH-access friction complaint, and independent corroboration of a smooth one-step IDE connection.
